en.title: Minimum Extra Chocolates
en.description:
Add a non-negative number of chocolates to each of the two boxes so that Drake's total becomes a positive integer multiple of Alex's total, and find the minimum total added. This site makes `k≥1`, `X,Y≥0` and the ranges explicit.

The company source is still Unknown; the input protocol added by this site does not represent the I/O of the original OAMaster problem.
en.input: One line with two positive integers A and B (1≤A,B≤10^9).
en.output: Output the minimum non-negative integer X+Y such that some positive integer k satisfies k(A+X)=B+Y.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for details.
hints: Once the multiple k is fixed, the optimal X only needs to bring the target total up to B.
Use the quotient ranges of ceil(B/k) to merge large values of k.
